claims.quote: From the Guyana states (French Guiana, Guyana and Surinam) there are for various reasons hardly any commercial ornamental fish exports.
Ancistrus leucostictus is endemic to Guyana, distributed throughout the middle and upper Essequibo River, and Demerara-Berbice River system.

regions.name: Essequibo
regions.quote: South America: Essequibo River basin and possibly all main Guianan rivers to the Oyapock River.

regions.quote: This is also true for Ancistrus leucostictus, which was brought back from a tributary of the Mazaruni River near its confluence with the Essequibo River by traveling aquarists in 2000.
